title: Model fusion compatibility and enterprise switch cost estimator
creator: Aisha Khan
description: Build a repeatable framework and practical estimator that quantifies the cost, risk, and compatibility work when enterprise customers either (a) switch production workloads between open models (model substitution) or (b) attempt a model fusion/ensemble (mixing weights, reranking, or cascades). This ticket coordinates PM research, vendor pricing collection, engineering inputs, and a first-version interactive spreadsheet calculator. Deliverables: 1) data model for estimator inputs (inference cost, latency delta, quantization/compatibility delta, throughput impact, retraining/eval effort, engineering migration days, contractual/license constraints); 2) populated benchmarking matrix for 8 representative models (LLM-A, LLM-B, LLM-C, and three quantized variants + two smaller on-prem variants); 3) an interactive Google Sheets estimator with scenario templates for Marketing, Search, and Secure Chat workloads; 4) migration playbook checklist and a short executive one-pager for Sales to use in procurement conversations.
